notes: CIRCUIT: five op-amp stages. Stage A (#2) is fed directly by the 5V source #5 with C0 (1uF) as feedback; its output drives R4 (1k) into stage B (#3), which has L1 (1uH) feedback and drives R6 (1k) into a common right-hand rail at x~915. Stage C (#11) is fed by the 10A source #15 with L9 (1uH) feedback; its output runs right/down into the long column at x~470 which feeds the in+ of stage B, R13 (1k) into stage D (#12, C10 1uF feedback) and C21 (1uF) into stage E (#20, L18 1uH feedback). Outputs of D and E reach the same right rail through R14 and R22. NET MAP: '0' = ground rail: bottom of V-DC #5, bottom of I-DC #15, the non-inverting (+) inputs of op-amps #2/#11/#12/#20 and GNDs #7,#8,#16,#17,#19,#23. n1 = top of V-DC #5, the y~232 wire left of op-amp #2, its in- and the left plate of C0. n2 = output of op-amp #2 at (438,251), right plate of C0, left end of R4. n3 = right end of R4 (see below), in- (top-left lead) of op-amp #3, left end of L1. n4 = output of op-amp #3 at (706,274), right end of L1, left end of R6. n5 = output of op-amp #11 at (351,612), right end of L9, the whole x~470 column from y~365 to y~805, the in+ (bottom-left lead) of op-amp #3, left end of R13, left plate of C21. n6 = the right-hand vertical rail at x~915 from y~272 to y~810: right ends of R6, R14 and R22 only (3-terminal floating summing node, as drawn). n7 = top of I-DC #15, in- (top-left) of op-amp #11, left end of L9. n8 = right end of R13, in- of op-amp #12, left plate of C10. n9 = output of op-amp #12 at (707,620), right plate of C10, left end of R14. n10 = right plate of C21, in- of op-amp #20, left end of L18. n11 = output of op-amp #20 at (714,813), right end of L18, left end of R22. SITES (all ten CRITICAL sites explicitly recorded, all junctions): S2 (273,229), S3 (438,251), S6 (737,273), S15 (202,596), S18 (589,606), S31 (574,808), S32 (770,814) are all clean T-intersections where a feedback-element leg lands on a horizontal wire - the leg terminates there, it does not continue past, so 'crossing' would leave that feedback leg (C0, L1, L9, C10, L18) floating on a one-terminal net; junction is the only electrically possible reading. S13 (352,551) has a fat drawn blob (dot score 3.2) where the output of op-amp #11 meets the right leg of L9; crossing would break the L9 feedback loop. S22 (896,624) is a T where the horizontal from R14 lands on the right rail; the rail is the right edge of the sheet so a crossing would strand R14.t1 alone. S19 (479,610) is the only genuine 4-way: inkmap at (479,610) shows a hand-drawn ring/blob ~8x12 px around the crossing against a 3 px stroke (dot score 3.1) - the drafter's deliberate solder dot - so junction: the x~470 column, the op-amp #11 output wire and the R13 input are one node (n5). The alternative reading (crossing) would split n5 into {op-amp #11 out, L9 right, R13 left} and {op-amp #3 in+, C21 left}, i.e. it would disconnect the C-stage output from stages D/E entirely; the drawn dot rules it out. Non-critical sites S5,S9,S10,S11,S12,S20,S21,S24,S26,S27,S28,S30,S34 are handwritten value-label ink brushing a wire or a component box and were left at the tracer default. PORT/PIN FIXES: all five op-amps needed pin reordering to the (in+, in-, out) convention. Every op-amp on this sheet is drawn with '-' on the upper input and '+' on the lower input, and every one has its feedback element returning to the upper lead, which confirms the marks. #2: t0->p2 (bottom '+', to GND #7), t1->p0 (top '-'), t2->p1 (apex/out). #3: t0->p0 (bottom '+'), t1->p2 (top '-'), t2->p1 (out). #11: t0->p2 (bottom '+', to GND #16), t1->p0 (top '-'), t2->p1 (out). #12 and #20: t0->p2 (bottom '+', to GND #17 / #23), t1->p1 (top '-'), t2->p0 (out). MERGE: resistor #4 (1k, centre (531,252)) had no right-hand port - the tracer took a stroke of the handwritten '1k ohm' label at (508,268) as terminal 1, producing a one-terminal net. The real right lead is the 12 px stub e11 (568,251)->(579,250) that runs into the in- of op-amp #3 and joins the left leg of L1 there, so 4.1 is merged onto L1.t0's net (n3). Verified in the #4 crop and with edges.py at (531,252). NOT RESOLVED / minor: nothing outstanding. All component classes agree with the drawing (5 Op-Amps, 5 Resistors, 3 Capacitors, 3 Inductors, 1 V-DC, 1 I-DC, 6 GND).
